description: Use this when the user attaches or links a photo and asks to remove its background, cut out the subject or get a transparent PNG. It returns the user's own photo with the background cut away by a matte, at its original size up to 2,048 pixels on the long edge, every subject pixel unchanged. Do not use to generate a new image. It cuts the subject out of the original photo with a matte. It takes the user's image as image (a file the user attached), imageUrl (https) or imageBase64, and returns the cutout, a share link, and Open in Brilliant.

imageBase64.description: The photo's bytes as base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 25 MB).

imageUrl.description: An https URL of the photo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 25 MB).

mimeType.description: The mime type of imageBase64 (optional, the bytes are sniffed).

name: remove_background
title: Remove a photo's background
